title: Design exercise: SAA-2.1-S07
scenario: Halden Rowe Legal Archive relies on four homegrown pieces that one senior engineer, retiring in three months, keeps alive. They are an SFTP server on a single EC2 instance used by 40 partner law firms with their existing clients, a cron script that rewrites the case database password every 30 days and restarts services, a Python script that walks each document through review steps that can span 10 days and records state in a table, and a self-hosted message broker between the intake and indexing programs. The firms will not change their SFTP clients. Patching and on-call are the risk, not missing features.
constraints: Do not claim live AWS experience
The 40 firms keep their existing SFTP clients with no change on their side
Password changes must not require restarts or redeployments
Each document's review history must be auditable per run

rubric.label: All four homegrown pieces are replaced by a managed service and none is re-implemented on servers
The review process that runs up to 10 days keeps per-run history

constraint_reason: Mapped as design_exercise to complete skill coverage when no dedicated live lab step exists
